title: coleus scutellarioides var. laciniatus
intro: Coleus scutellarioides var. laciniatus, commonly known as Variegated Coleus or Split-Leaf Coleus, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and skin irritations, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing fever and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Coleus scutellarioides var. laciniatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Further research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents of this plant and their effects on human health.
